events.intent: Jack chooses a crowded passage in Crosswater, activates a carried experimental gadget to try to disrupt and infect nearby devices, then leaves for a cafe in Market Row to inspect outcomes. He also requests no more numbered choices.
events.outcome: An isolated burst of visible glitches affects public signage and some nearby phones; no device infection, data theft, or blanket compromise is confirmed. Jack reaches Café Bruma and reviews inconclusive device results while transit staff begin to check anomalies.

state_changes.after: contiene gadget experimental activado una vez; efectos parciales y alcance desconocido

progression_awards.reason: Jack learned from first-hand observation that the prototype causes visible instability but does not provide evidence of successful device infection.
